title: Q-AGENT-OAUTH-1: an OAuth authorization server fronts /api/v1/intake so agents get scoped tokens through consent, not a pasted key
body:
**Owner:** Staff (platform)
**Trigger:** a second integration besides the personal companion needs write access
**Done check:** grep:site/agentic.js::oauth-protected-resource
**Status:** closed

Today /api/v1/intake takes a bearer key, so RFC 9728 and RFC 8414 discovery would be false and stay declined in doctrine/agent-standards.json. With a second writer, keys do not scale and break POINT-AND-CLICK-1. Add an authorization server on the tick Worker (client registration, consent screen, short-lived scoped tokens), then publish /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource and /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server. Closing probe: both documents answer 200 and an intake call with an issued token succeeds.

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (first pass): grep:site/agentic.js::oauth-protected-resource
